snippet.title: A Spooky Item Game - Official Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669400/A_Spooky_Item_Game/

Welcome to The Spire rookie!
Figure out what type of entity is haunting your object, correctly dispose of it and try not to fall victim to madness. Progress to uncover new hauntings, make it to the end of the week, and you might get yourself a pretty paycheck.

#horrorgame #steamwishlist #indiehorror
